tests.name: Cold start dark theme — no white flash
tests.steps: Launch app with dark theme cached → observe first frame
tests.expected: Window background is dark from frame 1, no white flash

tests.name: Cold start light theme — no dark flash
tests.steps: Clear cache or set light theme → launch
tests.expected: Window background is white/light from frame 1

tests.name: First-ever launch (no cache) — system dark
tests.steps: Clear localStorage → system dark mode → launch
tests.expected: CSS media query fallback sets dark background

tests.name: Splash dismount timing
tests.expected: Splash visible until theme applied, then fades out 120ms, no gap between splash and themed editor

tests.name: Watchdog fires on stuck boot
tests.expected: Error overlay appears after 5s timeout

tests.name: Switch to each dark theme
tests.steps: Settings → Theme → select each dark theme
tests.expected: Editor, sidebar, title bar all update. body.dark class added

tests.name: Switch to each light theme
tests.steps: Settings → Theme → select each light theme
tests.expected: Editor, sidebar, title bar all update. body.dark class removed

tests.name: Theme toggle button (title bar)
tests.steps: Click sun/moon toggle in title bar
tests.expected: Switches to paired light/dark theme from themePairs map

tests.name: Theme persistence across restart
tests.expected: Dracula theme loads on restart, localStorage has 'dracula'

tests.name: Custom CSS applied on top of theme
tests.steps: Settings → Custom CSS → add rule → verify
tests.expected: Custom CSS rule visible in DOM, overrides theme

tests.name: Rust code — VS Code Dark+ colors
tests.steps: Insert rust code block with fn, let, struct, String
tests.expected: Keywords pink, functions yellow, types teal, strings orange-ish

tests.name: JavaScript code — token separation
tests.steps: Insert JS code with class, function, parameter, const
tests.expected: class-name teal, function yellow, parameter distinct color

tests.name: All 31 Prism themes have distinct class-name color
tests.steps: Switch to each theme → check .token.class-name color
tests.expected: class-name color differs from function color in each theme

tests.name: Code block on light themes
tests.steps: Switch to light theme → insert code block
tests.expected: Syntax colors visible and readable on light background
